text:
Anya: Quick design check — I'm proposing a small change to the burst flow: add a "safety cap" next to Burst Max that prevents accidental huge allocations unless you explicitly toggle "override". mockup: https://figma.com/s/xxxx Matt: i like that. question: does safety cap live per-pool or per-tenant? Anya: per-pool by default; tenant-level override in advanced settings. keeps the common case simple. Sarah: accessibility nit — contrast on the slider thumb label is low on our dark theme. need 4.5:1 for the label text. also the label overlaps at small widths. Julian: can we show a tiny cost delta chip when they drag min/max? e.g., "+~$0.12/hr" so PMs see impact before saving. Kofi: keyboard behavior: arrow nudges by 1, shift+arrow by 10, and double-tap left/right to jump to pool suggested defaults. also Escape should revert to previous committed values. Anya: good keyboard suggestions. also thinking about a microcopy change for the burst confirmation modal — current copy says "Apply burst?" which is vague. propose: "Temporarily increase GPU pool to X for Y minutes. Costs may rise — proceed?" Matt: agree, more explicit. add a link to cost estimator in the modal (small icon). Sarah: for screen reader folks we need aria-valuetext on the SLO slider like "Latency SLO: 95th percentile goal 200ms". designbot flagged missing attribute. DesignBot: accessibility lint: detected slider without aria-valuetext. recommended snippet: ```html
``` Julian: UX question — when a pool switch would violate a safety cap, do we block it or show a soft warning + suggested alternatives? my vote: soft warning with automatic suggestion to lower burst or pick a different pool. Anya: soft warning + one-click suggestion. blocking is too aggressive for power users. Kofi: telemetry note: capture whether they used override toggle and whether they accepted suggested alternative — helps tune defaults. Matt: minor: the pool picker should surface "preemptible" status with an icon and accessible label, not just color. Sarah: +1. also include an aria-label like "Pool: g4dn (preemptible)". Anya: thanks—I'll update the mockup and microcopy. I'll push a new frame with the safety cap UI, keyboard hints, and cost chip. please review before EOD. :thumbsup: Matt: will review after standup. DesignBot: deploy-bot: mockup update uploaded to Figma by Anya at 2145012389 Kofi: tiny follow-up: can the safety cap default be 2x current committed capacity? seems reasonable for burst headroom without runaway cost. Anya: makes sense. I'll set default to 2x but make it editable per-pool. Sarah: leaving one last a11y checklist item: focus order for the burst modal needs to land on the primary CTA, then the override toggle, then cancel. Anya: noted, I’ll reorder elements in the next patch. Matt: thanks everyone — solid session.
